title: Arcane leveling, ticket panels, and site work began
summary: Added level and leaderboard commands, expanded ticket panels, began work on the TheySix site, and revised staff applications.
description: A busy day of updates: Arcane leveling was added, ticket panels were expanded, work began on the TheySix site, and staff applications were revised.

body.text: Added level and leaderboard commands, restored qualifying member levels, and introduced cumulative chat and booster XP boosts.
Added Java, Bedrock, Discord bug and member reports, partnerships, and the do-not-message scam-reporting channel.
Started the server site for farms, builds, events, and social links; planned renderer, uploads, notes, and wiki features.
Updated the staff-application link and added more questions.
